gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-mukta: Cut-paper winter drama up top. Mukta sits beneath it in tall-bodied small letters, a plain sans that lets Snowburst One's stencil bridges do the shouting.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-mukta-mahee: Mukta Mahee reads chunky and friendly, its lowercase standing tall. Snowburst One, with stencil bridges and wide-sprung openings, makes the sharpest foil for that sturdy sans-serif softness.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-mukta-malar: Approachable from the first line. Snowburst One brings stencil bridges and tall lowercase, while Mukta Malar tucks its ascenders short, and that restraint is the quality worth noticing.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-narnoor: Professional in tone, Narnoor keeps short ascenders above big bowls, giving the page a grounded footing. And Snowburst One, cut like a stencil sheet with bridges between letters, supplies the loud part while the sans stays out of its way.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-displa: Frosty stencil cuts with a tall lowercase lead the way, then Noto Sans Display follows with a big middle zone in every word. Paragraphs feel open and easy.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-play: Play reads crisp and businesslike, with cases close in height and a faint stroke shift between upstrokes and downstrokes. Snowburst One's stencil heft against that thinner sans-serif is the real draw.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-port-lligat-sans: Snowburst One cuts its tall lowercase like a stencil sheet, with wide bridges and sprung openings. Port Lligat Sans follows with half-finished bowls packed tight as pins in a cushion, so paragraphs read dense, modern and steady.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-ramabhadra: Stencil-cut and loud, Snowburst One grabs the eye with wide bridges and tall lowercase. Yet Ramabhadra, with its prominent x-height, steps in as a clean sans that gives the eye somewhere quiet to land.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-rambla: Rambla's small letters stand almost as tall as its capitals. Shrink Snowburst One's stencil heading too far and its wide bridges lose their punch against that sturdy sans-serif.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-recursive: Friendly and modern, Recursive keeps its stroke edges running parallel through every curve under a tall mean line. But Snowburst One's stencil bridges break that smoothness, so a long page feels lively without turning rough.
